# NanomaterialNeuralInterface

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The structural and functional interaction between engineered nanomaterials and neural tissue or neural network models, including signal transduction and biocompatibility. Underpins the development of novel neuromorphic hardware and sensors that interface directly with biological neural systems.
